turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Excuse me, do you have a minute? I did not understand the part about the deadline.

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Of course. The paper is due Friday da tsakar dare, but you can ask for an extension if you need one.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: So can I submit it on Monday?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Only if you email me kafin Juma'a and ask for an extension. Just explain why, and I will usually say yes.
